== frame cd_a cursor=1,22
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd a
|testuser@<HOST> ~/a $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@1 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/a
== frame cd_up cursor=3,20

== frame cd_dash cursor=5,24

|<HOME>/a/b
|testuser@<HOST> ~/a/b $
